entries.risk_area: Terminal escape/control-char injection from B1 stdin (model chip, cost, debug-log output)
entries.evidence: Full data flow mapped (sources :14,:75,:205,:317,:332; sinks :361-364,:243-253,:304-308; sanitizer :86-89; arithmetic sinks all num()-guarded and bash $(( ))/test do not command-substitute — verified empirically). entries.surface: scripts/zai-statusline.sh + scripts/quota-fetch.sh — cache/state file numeric fields → shell arithmetic
entries.risk_area: B4 cache/state tampering → bash arithmetic errors / statusline logic skew
entries.evidence: All numeric consumers traced: statusline :122/:164/:179-181/:209/:272 and fetch :64-66. num() whitelist is present on the statusline side; fetch's `|| echo 0` (:64) does not catch numeric-junk jq output from a tampered cache (H3); hook .hook-state/.turn timestamps guarded only partially (H6). No exec possible (bash arithmetic verified non-expanding) — open question is DoS/logic-skew only.

entries.risk_area: B2 response handling + credential handling (cache poisoning, header injection, token leakage)
entries.evidence: URL construction confirmed (fetch:82-88, https-enforced :83-87, default host api.z.ai from README:88); token passed as raw Authorization header :96, stored env-first/config.env-second (:56-57, :38-48 grep-parse, chmod 600 :54). Open hypotheses: H7 (jqsh exception paths on hostile body), H9 (newline-bearing token → curl header split), H2 (raw body `head -c 2000` :103,:112 into hook.log tail rendering).

entries.surface: scripts/quota-hook.sh — hook stdin session_id path use + B4 sweep
entries.evidence: session_id whitelist `[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*` at hook:53 / statusline:206 gates all `.turn[-sid]` path construction (:54-56, statusline:207). Looks correct; H4 asks a validator to probe jqsh/jq -r raw-output edges (number/string output forms) for whitelist bypass before ruling out.

entries.risk_area: Code execution via filter/data parsing; recursion, surrogates, unbounded resource use
entries.evidence: AST pass (ast-python-map.txt) shows zero eval/exec/compile/system/import sinks; only sink is open(files[0]) :616 and re.compile of fixed patterns :31. Tree-walking interpreter with fixed grammar; data-only untrusted input. Open: H7 resource/exception paths (parser RecursionError uncaught, lone-surrogate UnicodeEncodeError in emit, cartesian-product blowups on hostile data).

entries.risk_area: B3 remote update execution / integrity of installed scripts
entries.evidence: Not applicable: sync.sh:16-22 and ensure-current.sh:29-38 perform no network I/O and no remote version checks — they only copy/compare files already inside the plugin checkout; runtime update path is the Claude marketplace itself (outside repo). CI-level residual: semgrep flagged mutable action tags (ci.yml:12, release.yml:14,37) and missing dependabot cooldown (dependabot.yml:3).
gitleaks (38 commits, ~200 KB) and trufflehog both clean — /workspace/.source-aware/gitleaks.json and trufflehog.json empty; no keys/tokens in config.env examples (README uses placeholder).
